changelog: Fixed severe late map rendering and LOD pop-in: properly raised CStreaming::ms_memoryAvailable (128 MB ARM32 / 384 MB ARM64) before Init2 and excluded permanently resident 0.3.DL custom models from starving CStreaming::ms_memoryUsed
Fixed TextureDatabaseRuntime::UpdateStreaming being called with flush=true every frame (was purging 45 MB of streamed textures every frame) and removed unconditional per-100ms building eviction

Improved streaming throughput (dual-channel pump, on-foot IPL/collision preload, off-screen-first eviction), eliminated CEntity::Render matrix allocation thrash, and removed synchronous SetMaterial log flush stalls
